notes: New in 1.1.2: WEBSITE SYNC - if you use your account at crewcxp.com, the app and the website now keep each other's scan history matched. Generate a token on the website (Settings - App sync), paste it in the app's new Settings - Website sync card, and press Sync now; settled scans flow both ways, each side always keeps its own record, and an optional switch syncs every finished scan automatically. FASTER SCANS - the read is about a third quicker on the same capture, and the capture engine now scrolls in exact 3-row steps (about 17 pages for a full crew instead of 26), so a full scan lands minutes sooner. Also everything from the unreleased 1.1.1: delete any scan from Deep Dive's history when a read goes bad (a backup is made first; title awards are never touched); the Discord post tracks crew level - a Level up celebration when a scan gains a level, plus the running tally since Friday's reset; a bad read can no longer brand a member 'Online, not grinding'; Find duplicates in the Activity Log merges member records that OCR split into two spellings; Settings is now a stack of trays that fold away once complete. Plus the 1.1.0 visual release: two skins (Premium and Broadcast), jackpot number rolls, Discord title roles, the day-locked MVP with lifetime tally, Ironman, the weekly Pumpfaker, renamable titles, and the Activity Log with your own Active bars.
